ModuleTitle.helper: Administrator-facing title for this module. This syncs with DNN module settings and does not display to visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionEyebrow.helper: Optional. Small label shown above the section heading.

SectionHeading.helper: Required. Centered heading shown above the cards. HTML is allowed.

IntroText.helper: Optional. Supporting copy shown below the heading. HTML is allowed.
IntroText.placeholder: Explore adjacent evaluation paths that connect mission data, geospatial workflows, network analysis, and deployable compute.

CentralLogoType.helper: Choose whether the center of the orbit renders a Font Awesome icon or an uploaded image.

CentralIconClass.helper: Font Awesome class for the center icon.

CentralLogoImage.helper: Image used in the center when Central Logo Type is Image. For this site, use the Portexa logo image.

CentralLogoAltText.helper: Accessible alt text for the center image. Falls back to the module or section label when empty.

Cards.helper: Add one to four cards. The editor allows up to four cards.

Eyebrow.helper: Optional. Small category label shown above the card title.

Description.helper: Optional. Card body copy. HTML is allowed.
Description.placeholder: Coordinate command, control, communications, computers, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance workflows.

Link.helper: Optional. When set, the full card renders as a clickable link.

OpenInNewWindow.helper: Open the card link in a new browser tab.

OrbitItems.helper: Add decorative orbit chips. Use existing Font Awesome classes only. Items are positioned automatically by display order within each orbit.

Label.helper: Required. Internal label and hover title for the decorative chip.

IconClass.helper: Optional. Existing Font Awesome class. Falls back to fas fa-circle.

OrbitNumber.helper: Choose which dotted orbit ring should contain this item.
